answer: Hold payment in escrow until the epoch finalizes, and forbid any identity from auditing its own recruit. On call the failure mode is obvious: a farm grades its own children, passes them, and cashes out before anyone looks. Escrow plus a no-self-audit rule makes the payout wait six hours while an unrelated panel reads the work, so a thousand-account orchard must survive a thousand independent reviews before a coin moves. A meadow of fake accounts cannot cross that canyon.
